LESSON: BIBLE PATRIARCHS ABRAHAM

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Holy Bible
Topic 2.6: Bible Patriarchs Abraham

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Bible Patriarchs Abraham. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why was the name Abram changed?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. obey God’s instructions in his or her day-to-day life
2. discuss Abram’s change of name to Abraham
3. appreciate God’s blessings in his or her life

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: BIBLE PATRIARCHS ABRAHAM
This lesson teaches Bible Patriarchs Abraham for Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

STUDY STEPS
1. obey God’s instructions in his or her day-to-day life
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. discuss Abram’s change of name to Abraham
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. appreciate God’s blessings in his or her life
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Bible Patriarchs Abraham using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Bible Patriarchs Abraham above.
2. Explain Bible Patriarchs Abraham to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Bible Patriarchs Abraham.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Bible Patriarchs Abraham with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Bible Patriarchs Abraham important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why was the name Abram changed?
2. How did Abraham show obedience to God?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. obey God’s instructions in his or her day-to-day life
2. discuss Abram’s change of name to Abraham
3. appreciate God’s blessings in his or her life

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
